entities.summary: Chaisson Stewart Allen is an American former professional basketball player and current assistant coach for the Phoenix Suns of the National Basketball Association (NBA). Originally from Nashville, Tennessee, he stands at 6 ft 4 in (1.93 m) tall and played as a point guard / shooting guard.
